ctx.x: Ike. Ike Alexander. So he was really responsible for rearing her, he and my grandmother, her mother. Her name was Winnie, Winnie Alexander.

You mentioned your sister Blanche. Because when I look at your other siblings, Ronnie, who was probably the most other – shall we say, successful. He’s so much younger than you. So Blanche was probably more contemporary in age with you.
